title: Huawei OceanStor Pacific cluster-manager connector configuration

endpoint_port.description: No default is set: unlike Dorado, Pacific's default management port was not independently confirmed during connector construction, so this connector requires it to be configured explicitly rather than guessed.

credential_reference_id.description: References a username:password pair, not a pre-built Authorization header -- Pacific's real cluster-manager REST API is session-based (POST .../api/v2/aa/sessions), the same rationale as the Huawei Dorado candidate. See source-provenance.json.
